engine_rules.caregiver_lock_precedence: If caregiver locked adaptive recommendations, lock is absolute (return None / maintain active tier).
engine_rules.patient_request_precedence: Immediate patient assistance requests (e.g., clicking repeat or requesting hint) bypass all model reasoning and execute instantly.
